subject.title: feat(ui): redesign settings as a full-page takeover with sidebar navigation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this full-page settings takeover/sidebar as the permanent desktop settings pattern?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it changes a primary Control UI navigation pattern and the PR carries a protected maintainer label, so automation should not decide the product direction alone.

options.title: Accept the takeover
options.body: Proceed with the shell-level settings sidebar after exact-head CI if maintainers want settings to behave like a dedicated workspace.

options.title: Request UX narrowing
options.body: Keep the route grouping idea but ask for narrower visual or interaction changes before merge.

options.title: Reject the direction
options.body: Keep the existing settings layout and close or re-scope the linked issue around a different navigation treatment.

recommendation.title: Accept the takeover
recommendation.body: Proceed with the shell-level settings sidebar after exact-head CI if maintainers want settings to behave like a dedicated workspace.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main owner signal for the sidebar/navigation surface and is also the sponsor of the linked UX proposal.
